basis: 0.3.0 on the branch: the gateway core with no product verbs; the mail verbs moved to rightkit-mail-gateway 0.1.0, and rightkit-remote-gateway runs on it. Read in full on 2026-11-11 (docs/audits/2026-11-11-shape-matrix/reports/agent-platform-redraw.md)
shapeReason: The name now says what it holds: agent registry (MailRight's: several agents, hashed key, level, scopes, revoke; generic over a Level), the gate's ordered checks over a static Method table with stable Denied codes (Pulse's order and codes), one audit row per call (conclude, Required or BestEffort), AuditSink with a SQL sink, Origin (Pulse's door), untrusted-content wrapping and stamping, and one redaction module (Pulse's masking plus MailRight's leak check). Refusal is the approvals core's; pending approvals are rightkit-approvals. Both gateways run on it. Gaps: Pulse's tools are not yet a Method table (its manifest is runtime JSON) and the activity file writer is still in rightkit-owner-approvals.
